acceptance_criteria.criterion: API.getDialogues(slug, wpId) makes a GET /api/projects/{slug}/dialogues?wp={wpId} request.
API.getDialogueContent(slug, filename) makes a GET /api/projects/{slug}/dialogues/{filename} request.
The WP detail view includes a 'Dialogues' card rendered after the Handoff Notes card.
When no dialogues are returned, the card shows a 'no dialogues' message and no buttons.
When dialogues are returned, each filename appears as an interactive element labeled with its human-readable name (stage + revision, e.g. developer-r0).
Clicking a dialogue element fetches and renders the content as Markdown using marked.parse().
Clicking a second dialogue collapses the previously expanded one.
A fetch error shows an inline error message; it does not crash the rest of the WP view.
The Dialogues card does not appear above the Pipelines card in the rendered DOM.
All existing work-package.js rendering behavior is preserved (acceptance criteria list, pipeline badges, pipeline items, handoff notes still render correctly).
